name: Grilled Chicken, Bell Pepper & Zucchini Tacos with Spicy Apricot Sauce

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 apricots
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Small dice the flesh and place in a medium saucepan.

Add sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, salt, and crushed red pepper to the pan with the apricots. Set pan over medium-low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until apricots are soft and juicy, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the chicken and cook until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a large plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve pan for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, trim and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and quarter bell pepper; add to the bowl with the zucchini. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches, add veggies and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Add to the plate with the chicken.
When the apricots are done, remove from heat. Use a potato masher to mash and combine a semi-smooth sauce. Set aside.
Transfer grilled chicken and veggies to the cutting board and roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates, fill with grilled chicken and veggies, then top with apricot sauce. Enjoy!
